title: Bound chapter identity reviews and avoid duplicate site qualification
body:
Large independent chapter identity packets were exhausting useful review context, while people-site verification reconstructed the full certified corpus twice. Split fresh reviews into lossless 256 KiB parts, retain exact pinned transport policies and actual independent producer provenance, and use the fresh context returned by certificate validation for all site artifact checks.

Each part still contains the complete target chapter and every owned person/anchor witness. Missing policies, oversized individual cases, wrong producers and incomplete coverage fail explicitly. Retained larger layouts require their original policy. The verifier keeps full current-source qualification, exact certificate comparison, preview restrictions and missing-status gating.

Validation: 61 identity regression checks passed on the unchanged identity code; both native publication tests pass with a new forged-certificate rejection. Independent review approved the exact current head with zero findings. Required CI is running at https://github.com/GarrettPetersen/records-of-the-grand-historian/actions/runs/41974903127. Production timing after this change remains unmeasured; this PR does not claim a newly completed chapter.
